method: Fixed 742-address intersection (483 EOAs + 259 storage contracts) present byte-identical in every state, sampled via proof_getProofWithMeta on the wip-v21-proof build. mainnet @24954458, x3.5 = PRISTINE @24358000, x5 = rebloat @24546596. Seed 27 (state-benchmarks issue #27).
storageLabel: account + 1-slot storage proof, total bytes p50
crossClient: Witness bytes are client-agnostic — EIP-1186 proofs are byte-identical across clients for the same state root. Verified Geth v1.17.3 vs Nethermind at 3.5× (per-proof Δ = 0). Besu / Reth / Erigon use the same fixed address set; pending.
finding: Typical witness depth stays at 8 levels across all milestones — individual proofs barely grow (+6–7% to 5×). A 16-slot combined witness is ~23–24 KB and stable across milestones and clients. The witness blow-up comes from touching more state per block, not bigger proofs.
note: 1× / 3.5× / 5× are measured on the same address set and are directly comparable. 7× and 10× are pending.
